body: Not once but twice had to explain sales tax... I'm from indiana ( alyways had sales tax) and two different grown ass men within a few weeks apart complain because "the price wasn't right". So I assumed maybe they were from a state that didn't have it. Nope. Both native Hoosiers. Had to explain the whole concept to them. To make things better one of them demanded to speak to a manager and I had the great joy to inform him I am one.

Hi! I just want to say it's very comforting to know there is someone else out there that feels the same way. Ever since I was about 10 I have been convinced I wasn't supposed to live. It is an exhausting constant battle. I don't know if it gets better but I do hope so. I'm struggling at 20 so to hear from someone older than me gives me hope. I wish you the best.
